aw26|Roaring Twenties.story: 1920s flapper glamour returns. Drop waists, swinging fringe, beading and long pearls lead evening, and the same codes cross into daywear through T-bar heels, velvet and pleated skirts.
aw26|Roaring Twenties.why: Party-season demand meets nostalgia for glamour. Drop waists are easier to wear than bodycon, which helps them sell beyond evening.
cost: High
Fringe and beading add hand labour. Keep cost down with machine fringe, placement beading at the neckline only, and printed sequin effects for value ranges.
actions: Lead evening with one drop-waist dress in two lengths.
Add fringe to hems and sleeves rather than the whole garment.
Pair with T-bar heels and long pearls in visual merchandising.

aw26|Power tailoring.story: Sharp, slick suiting in pinstripes and slate grey, with pointed shoulders, peak lapels and double-breasted fronts. Oxblood accents and polished heels finish the look.
aw26|Power tailoring.why: Return-to-office dressing and a move away from very oversized blazers toward sharper fits.
brands: Up 4% year on year; pointed shoulders up 12%
aw26|Power tailoring.src: Who What Wear (AW26 trends); Trendalytics, top menswear runway trends FW26
cost: Medium
Structured shoulders and canvassing add make time. Fused construction keeps value prices; pinstripe fabric needs stripe matching at seams, which adds cutting waste.
actions: Offer the pinstripe suit as separates so customers can mix sizes.
Use pointed shoulders on jackets, but keep trousers relaxed.
Add a waistcoat that works alone as a top.

aw26|Preppy sport.story: School and playing-field references: rugby shirts, cricket cables, varsity jackets and oversized statement collars and cuffs.
aw26|Preppy sport.why: Heritage sportswear feels familiar and gift-friendly, and collars and cuffs update basics at low cost.
brands: Named a top menswear runway trend
aw26|Preppy sport.src: Trendalytics, top menswear runway trends FW26; Who What Wear, AW26 trends
cost: Low to medium
Contrast collars and cuffs are a cheap update to existing blocks. Cable knits use more yarn; keep cables to the front panel in value ranges.
actions: Add white contrast collars to existing shirt blocks.
Build one striped rugby shirt in three colourways.
Use tipping on knit V-necks and cuffs.

aw26|Big outerwear.story: Oversized, protective outerwear: shearling, big fur collars, leather bombers and sculptural cocoon coats.
aw26|Big outerwear.why: Outerwear is a high-value hero category, and leather bombers are growing fast.
brands: Leather jacket as the hero piece
aw26|Big outerwear.src: Trendalytics, top menswear runway trends FW26; Harrods, AW26 menswear trends; Who What Wear
cost: High
Large pattern pieces and heavy fabrics raise fabric cost. Use faux shearling and PU for value; save real leather for premium.
actions: Pick one hero coat per range and build marketing around it.
Offer detachable fur collars to stretch one coat into two looks.
Pair bombers with knitwear in outfit-led merchandising.

aw26|Fully loaded.story: Embellishment moves from evening onto everyday pieces: sequinned jeans, beaded knits, feathers and sheer layers over heavier fabrics.
aw26|Fully loaded.why: Social media rewards texture and shine, and embellishment makes basics feel special.
aw26|Fully loaded.src: Who What Wear, AW26 trends (the source describes the trend without naming brands)
cost: High
Hand embellishment is the biggest cost driver. Use machine sequin fabric, heat-set studs or placement embellishment only.
actions: Embellish one area per garment (pocket, cuff or yoke).
Use sheer layers to restyle existing knits.
Keep embellished pieces as limited drops.

ss27|The waist returns.story: After years of oversized shapes the waist is back. Peplums, basque waists, balloon and bubble shapes and belted or wrapped fronts define the body again.
ss27|The waist returns.why: Forecasters see a return to elegance and shape. A defined waist refreshes existing silhouettes without new categories.
brands: Wraps and belts the waist tightly
Corseted bodices, basque waists and bubble skirts
cost: Low to medium
Waist seams and peplums use existing blocks with a cut at the waist. Bubble hems need a lining and more fabric.
actions: Add a peplum version of your best-selling blouse.
Cut a basque-waist seam into a core dress block.
Sell double belts as an add-on accessory.

ss27|Handcraft.story: Lace flowers, embroidery and smocking move onto crisp, everyday shirting. Craft techniques such as wrapping, gathering, pleating and openwork feel personal and slow.
ss27|Handcraft.why: Lace is named a growth category, and craft adds perceived value to simple poplin and knits.
brands: Forecasters call it a growth category
ss27|Handcraft.src: FashionUnited, SS27 Paris coverage and SS27 trend report
cost: Medium to high
Hand embroidery and crochet are slow. Use Schiffli embroidery, lace trims and machine smocking for scale; India has strong craft clusters for premium ranges.
actions: Add lace trims at cuffs and hems of core shirts.
Use machine smocking on bodices and cuffs.
Partner with a craft cluster for a premium capsule.

ss27|Undone.story: A deliberately unfinished look: straps falling off the shoulder, exposed or unhooked undergarments, top layers left unsewn and raw, frayed hems on muslin-like cottons.
ss27|Undone.why: A relaxed, personal take on elegance, and raw edges suit natural fabrics.
ss27|Undone.src: The Zoe Report, NYFW SS27 trends; FashionUnited, SS27 Paris coverage
cost: Low
Raw edges skip hemming, but fabrics must be chosen so they fray evenly and pass wash tests.
actions: Test raw hems in wash trials before bulk.
Layer a longer slip under existing dresses.
Style straps off-shoulder in imagery, not just in the garment.

ss27|In motion.story: Long fringe that moves with every step, and bold head-to-toe stripes, from rainbow to tonal.
ss27|In motion.why: Movement and stripes photograph well for video-led social media.
brands: Luar, Kim Shui, Ulla Johnson, Heirlome, Monse
ss27|In motion.src: The Zoe Report, NYFW SS27 trends
cost: Medium
Fringe adds trim cost and QC time. Stripes need matching at seams; yarn-dyed stripes cost more than prints.
actions: Use fringe on hems only to control cost.
Offer stripes as co-ord sets.
Shoot in motion for e-commerce and reels.

ss27|Elegant ease.story: Dressing gets refined again. The tie returns, shirts are tucked in, trousers are pleated and slightly puffed, and elegant mules and pointed flats replace sneakers.
ss27|Elegant ease.why: Fabric forecasters say street style and sneakers are giving way to elegance.
brands: Slimmer ties, pleated and puffed trousers
ss27|Elegant ease.src: FashionUnited, SS27 Paris coverage and SS27 trend report
cost: Low
Mostly styling and small accessories. Pleated trousers reuse existing blocks; mules use less leather than closed shoes.
actions: Add slim ties and pocket squares as add-on sales.
Style shirts tucked into pleated trousers in imagery.
Shift footwear mix from sneakers toward mules and flats.

ss27|Reworked denim.story: Denim reimagined: white cut-off shorts, cobalt-painted jeans, wax-coated bootcuts, embroidered and beaded denim, upcycled pieces and matching denim suits.
ss27|Reworked denim.why: Denim is a core volume category, and new finishes refresh it without new fits.
ss27|Reworked denim.src: The Zoe Report, NYFW SS27 trends; FashionUnited, SS27 Paris coverage
cost: Medium
Coatings and special washes add processing cost and water use. Cut-offs are cheap; denim suits need consistent shade across pieces.
actions: Add a coated finish to one core fit.
Sell denim suits as matching separates.
Shade-band jacket and jeans together to avoid mismatches.

aw27|Waisted outerwear.story: The defined waist moves into winter outerwear: belted and double-belted coats, wrap fronts and cinched jackets.
aw27|Waisted outerwear.why: SS27 brought the waist back; outerwear is the natural next step for autumn.
aw27|Waisted outerwear.src: Runway shows for this season have not happened yet. Forecut will add the brands showing this theme once collections are presented.
cost: Medium
Belts and loops add small trim costs. Wrap coats need more fabric than single-breasted.
actions: Add a self-belt to your core coat.
Test a double-belt version in one colour.
Carry SS27 peplum jackets into wool.

aw27|Winter handcraft.story: Craft continues into the cold season: smocking on knit cuffs and hems, tonal embroidery on wool and crochet textures.
aw27|Winter handcraft.why: Handcraft from SS27 carries on, adapted to heavier fabrics.
aw27|Winter handcraft.src: Runway shows for this season have not happened yet. Forecut will add the brands showing this theme once collections are presented.
cost: Medium
Tonal embroidery costs less than multicolour. Mohair yarn is expensive; blends keep value prices.
actions: Move SS27 smocking details onto knit cuffs.
Use tonal embroidery to keep it subtle.
Offer mohair blends at mid price.

aw27|Quiet structure.story: Clean lines: pleated wool trousers, funnel necks, concealed closures and straight shapes without decoration.
aw27|Quiet structure.why: A calmer reaction to heavy embellishment, and pieces that last more than one season.
aw27|Quiet structure.src: Runway shows for this season have not happened yet. Forecut will add the brands showing this theme once collections are presented.
cost: Low
Simple constructions; quality of fabric matters more than details.
actions: Invest in fabric quality over trims.
Build a capsule of five clean core pieces.
Use concealed plackets to update shirts.

aw27|Deep blue.story: The 2027 colour of the year, Luminous Blue, deepens for winter into cobalt and ink on knitwear, wool coats and leather.
aw27|Deep blue.why: Colours of the year usually carry through both seasons of their year in adapted shades.
aw27|Deep blue.src: Based on the WGSN × Coloro 2027 colour of the year, Luminous Blue. Runway shows for this season have not happened yet. Forecut will add the brands showing this theme once collections are presented.
cost: Low
A colour story, not new construction. Lab-dip early for shade consistency across fabrics.
actions: Lab-dip cobalt and ink shades across knit, woven and leather.
Use deep blue as a core neutral, not just an accent.
Pair with cognac and cream.

aw27|Soft boots.story: Flat riding boots, slim soles and soft leather replace chunky lugs.
aw27|Soft boots.why: Footwear follows the move to elegance; slimmer soles suit refined trousers and skirts.
aw27|Soft boots.src: Runway shows for this season have not happened yet. Forecut will add the brands showing this theme once collections are presented.
cost: Medium
Knee-high shafts use more leather; slim soles cost less than chunky lugs.
actions: Reduce lug-sole depth in new styles.
Add a flat knee-high riding boot.
Offer wide-calf fits.

ss28|Structured clarity.story: Consumers move away from constant novelty toward fewer, better pieces: clean column shapes, clear lines and minimal trims.
ss28|Structured clarity.why: Early SS28 trade intelligence describes a demand for "better" fashion rather than more fashion.
ss28|Structured clarity.src: FashionUnited, "Spring Summer 2028 Trend Intelligence: The Rise of Structured Clarity". Runway shows for this season have not happened yet. Forecut will add the brands showing this theme once collections are presented.
cost: Low
Fewer trims, but fabric and fit must be excellent because there is nothing to hide behind.
actions: Edit ranges down and deepen buys on proven fits.
Upgrade fabrics on core styles.
Tell a "made to last" story.

ss28|Performance ease.story: Designs that feel intuitive and move easily: articulated sleeves and knees, stretch and breathable fabrics for sport and commuting.
ss28|Performance ease.why: Early SS28 previews point to performance design that removes restriction.
ss28|Performance ease.src: FashionUnited, "SS28 Preview: The modern flow of performance design". Runway shows for this season have not happened yet. Forecut will add the brands showing this theme once collections are presented.
cost: Medium
Technical fabrics and bonded seams need special machines; articulation adds pattern pieces.
actions: Add stretch to core tailoring fabrics.
Introduce articulated elbows on outerwear.
Test breathability claims before marketing them.

ss28|Commuter tailoring.story: Suits built for city days: stretch suiting, soft shoulders, concealed buttons and easy-care fabrics.
ss28|Commuter tailoring.why: Hybrid working needs tailoring that is comfortable on a commute and smart at a desk.
ss28|Commuter tailoring.src: Runway shows for this season have not happened yet. Forecut will add the brands showing this theme once collections are presented.
cost: Medium
Stretch wool blends cost more than polyester; unstructured jackets save canvas cost.
actions: Launch a machine-washable suit.
Use soft, unlined construction.
Market comfort and care, not just looks.

ss28|Natural tech.story: Natural fibres finished to perform: quick-dry linen, UV-resistant cotton and easy-care jersey.
ss28|Natural tech.why: Customers want natural fibres without the creasing and care trouble.
ss28|Natural tech.src: Runway shows for this season have not happened yet. Forecut will add the brands showing this theme once collections are presented.
cost: Medium
Performance finishes add processing cost; certified fibres cost more but support the story.
actions: Specify finishes (quick-dry, UV) with mills early.
Use certified fibres where possible.
Label care benefits clearly.

ss28|Sport meets smart.story: Cushioned sport soles under refined flats, loafers and derbies: elegant shoes with sneaker comfort.
ss28|Sport meets smart.why: SS27 moved from sneakers to elegance; SS28 keeps the look but brings back comfort.
ss28|Sport meets smart.src: Runway shows for this season have not happened yet. Forecut will add the brands showing this theme once collections are presented.
cost: Medium
Sport soles need new moulds; reuse sole units across several uppers to spread tooling cost.
actions: Develop one sport sole and use it across three uppers.
Market comfort features with clear claims.
Keep uppers refined to stay smart.

aw28|Functional tailoring.story: Tailoring that works hard: belted jackets, useful pockets, clean seams and cargo details in wool.
aw28|Functional tailoring.why: Continues SS28 performance thinking into winter suiting.
aw28|Functional tailoring.src: Runway shows for this season have not happened yet. Forecut will add the brands showing this theme once collections are presented.
cost: Medium
Extra pockets add make time; keep them flat and functional.
actions: Add one useful pocket to core tailoring.
Belt a suit jacket.
Offer a utility vest as a layering piece.

aw28|Technical wool.story: Wool that stretches, sheds rain and resists creases, for suits and coats that travel well.
aw28|Technical wool.why: Natural fibre with performance benefits fits the "fewer, better" shift.
aw28|Technical wool.src: Runway shows for this season have not happened yet. Forecut will add the brands showing this theme once collections are presented.
cost: High
Technical wool is a premium fabric; use blends for mid prices.
actions: Source technical wool samples early.
Test water resistance and stretch recovery.
Position as investment pieces.

aw28|Earth deepens.story: The 2028 colour of the year, Radiant Earth, deepens into rust and brick, often on quilted and padded pieces.
aw28|Earth deepens.why: Colours of the year carry into winter in deeper shades.
aw28|Earth deepens.src: Based on the WGSN × Coloro 2028 colour of the year, Radiant Earth. Runway shows for this season have not happened yet. Forecut will add the brands showing this theme once collections are presented.
cost: Medium
Quilting adds machine time; suede costs more than smooth leather.
actions: Lab-dip rust and brick shades early.
Add quilting to dresses and skirts.
Pair with charcoal and oatmeal.

aw28|Hybrid boots.story: Smart boots on cushioned sport soles: Chelseas, hikers and weatherproof derbies.
aw28|Hybrid boots.why: Winter version of SS28 sport-meets-smart footwear.
aw28|Hybrid boots.src: Runway shows for this season have not happened yet. Forecut will add the brands showing this theme once collections are presented.
cost: Medium
Reuse SS28 sport sole units to save tooling cost.
actions: Carry SS28 sole units into boots.
Add weatherproofing for monsoon and winter markets.
Keep uppers sleek.

aw28|Hidden closures.story: Magnetic and concealed fastenings give clean, uninterrupted fronts on coats, shirts and blazers.
aw28|Hidden closures.why: Supports the minimal, structured look and is easier to fasten.
aw28|Hidden closures.src: Runway shows for this season have not happened yet. Forecut will add the brands showing this theme once collections are presented.
cost: Low to medium
Magnets cost more than buttons and must pass wash and safety tests.
actions: Test magnets for washing and safety.
Use fly-front plackets on core shirts.
Market ease of fastening.
